reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to All Ears for a year and a half since moving to Brooklyn. Their care is stellar and excellent, medical summaries get delivered to you on the same day. It’s easy to get same day or next day appointments and they don’t push procedures or treatments on you, and the wait time in the clinic is minimal.
All in all truly excellent care and service

Before my first visit, they had already reviewed all of my vets prior records, and were deeply familiar with his history. And they even have a cat only room full of Churu and treats

I bring my fur baby here about 3 weeks ago for the first time to get checked out and I am glad I found this place. They are so friendly, from the moment you Walk in the door. I chatted and laughed with reception as they played with my dogs. When it was time to see the vet I was able to remain in the room with my fur baby and the vet & staff were friendly and very patient. They answered all of my questions without trying to rush or hurry away. The vet knows her job and does it well. The place is clean and pet friendly from the front end to the back. Your fur babies can even run around and play in the exam room. My fur baby was comfortable and enjoying his self.

I took my kitty in to check out a messed up claw and they took fantastic care of my boy! They saw him within an hour of me making the appointment, and were incredibly friendly and comforting to both my boy and I. Couldn’t have had a better experience!

The facility itself is welcoming and clean. Everyone on staff from reception to the care team was so lovely and helpful.  I’ve been to other big name chain vets in the past that felt like they were trying to rack up the bill more than care for my pet.  All Ears is such a refreshing experience and nothing like those other establishments.  I can’t recommend it highly enough!
Front staff, nurse and vet herself were all very nice and compassionate when handling Samara. All of my questions were answered and their level of care helped me a lot regarding Samaras health

Great experience! The staff was so kind and treated Halo so well. Halo seemed really comfortable with everyone, which made me feel at ease too. The vet was very informative and took the time to explain everything. So happy we came here!
The vets here were so lovely and helpful!

I had a wellness check at All Ears for my rabbit, and Dr. Nieto and her team were very knowledgeable about rabbits and provided gentle, excellent care. I used to be a volunteer with a rabbit rescue organization in nyc, so I was a little skeptical at first about going to a new vet, but I believe my rabbit is in great hands with Dr. Nieto. Her post visit report was very helpful and thorough, and gave excellent info about how to keep my rabbit healthy and happy.

I had a great experience here today! I brought my snake in and I was really impressed by the staff’s expertise. I’ve been to a couple exotic vets that know a lot about snakes as far as anatomy and health, but as far as the nuances of husbandry, they’ve been lacking. That is absolutely not the case here. It’s clear they know what they’re talking about. Their expertise adds so much to their advice and overall understanding of reptile welfare. I absolutely will continue to be a client of this practice! Thank you All Ears!

Our RES Turtle came here twice and they were very thorough and explained everything in detail during the appointment, as well as with follow up notes. He recently passed, and the woman we dealt with at time of dropping him off  and also picking up was an absolute gem. She was so kind, patient, and considerate through the entire process which is all you can ask for in that situation. We didn't feel rushed at all and we felt our RES was handled very compassionately and respectfully. There was no rush to pick him up and who I spoke to on the phone was very gentle explaining that they'd keep him safe until we were ready. While it is very depressing circumstances to be writing this review, I'm thankful this was our vet during this time. I'd definitely consider them for any future vet needs in the area :)
Staff was very warm and welcoming. They took excellent care of my fur baby. Took extra care with his health.

This place is so great I almost want to gatekeep it. I found this place via Reddit thread after moving to Brooklyn and not having my same vet as before so decided to give it a shot. The front desk personnel were so nice and accommodating. The Vet, Dr. Kasprow, was amazing! She took the time to explain everything that was going on with my cat and truly cared about my cat’s health. Lastly, the nurses and assistants were so nice and friendly. So happy to have found my cats’ new vet!

From the front desk staff to the vet techs to the veterinarians, everyone was super caring and transparent with pricing. My baby was seen in a very timely manner and I felt very confident in the care she received. Thank you!
Yes all is well but the price for blood work for animals is a bit expensive  all else is pretty fair

I made an appointment here on a whim because my previous vet is not open on weekends. I am very thankful I found this place! They made a stressful experience as seamless as possible! Thank you especially to Tiera, Alex, and Dr. Ryan

From the moment I entered until the end of the appointment, everyone was great. I don’t recall the front desk person and didn’t get the name of the assistant who held my pups while they were being examined but they were great along with Dr Fortier and Tiffany. Glad I found you all and feel my Teddy and Graham are in good hands. Thank you.
I love the staff at All Ears! Best vet in Brooklyn from the second you check in to when you leave. Thank you for taking care of my baby!

Everyone was so kind, from the front desk to the nurse! My cat behaved very nicely, and even though she tried climbing me and my husband, I could tell she was comfortable with the staff during her interactions with them. Dr. Fortier listened to and looked into my concerns and I felt validated and calmed upon leaving our visit. Thank you guys!

Went in with my cat for an emergency, everything was done in the room with us, the bills are very transparent and well priced. As a bonus there was a cat scratcher she used there and a cat bed she stayed in during the check-up of her vitals! Also they gave us a 50 dollar discount for being a first time patient so I highly recommend this place if you’re looking for an stress-free vet that doesn’t break the wallet!

After a week of feeling in the dark with our last vet, I really appreciate that the All Ears team took my dog’s issue seriously. They were very detail oriented and provided a thorough follow up report same day with clear next steps. We don’t know exactly what’s wrong yet but the pain meds  are helping my dog in the meantime and I can tell we will get there. Really appreciate the compassion and support from this team.

Honestly I never really write reviews, but this place was above and beyond on multiple levels so I felt compelled to spell it out: DON'T SLEEP ON ALL EARS VET. I've been to dozens of vets as I foster dogs for several rescues, dogsit often, and have had my own dog...this was by far the best service and environment I've experienced in my 15 years in the city.

People say superlatives like this pretty loosely, but I give more weight to reviews that spell out the "why" of a rating, high or low:

1. They scheduled me quickly and efficiently- huge pro when you're a busy professional and a surprise vet emergency pops up.
2. The front desk staff kept an eye on my car during our appointment as it was parked at a questionable (but safe) distance from a hydrant. This was truly next level service!!
3. The lobby and exam rooms were both immaculate and yet felt warm and inviting, not purely sterile and impersonal.
4. The staff was knowledgeable, caring towards my dog, and they took the time to give us their full attention. At no point did I feel rushed (which is especially hard to find in NYC).
5. The place is (perhaps surprisingly based on how nice the interiors are) independently owned and operated by people based in the neighborhood who dedicate their lives to animals. This is not like the PE-backed Vet group that rhymes with Pond (no shade to their individual providers as I have no experience with them, but let's not be fooled into choosing veterinary care based primarily on cute interiors and strategic marketing). It's always nice to support small independent businesses, but it's especially easy to do so when the owners are actually personally invested in the business and their customers. Whether this resonates with you or not, the fact that the experience on the ground was so wonderful for both me and my dog is reason enough alone to come check this place out!
6. They had sparkling water on tap in the waiting area. I had to stifle a little squeal.

I will be driving her from Manhattan for any future vet care.
Very friendly people, lots of help. 50$ off first  visit.
Very friendly compassionate understanding atmosphere

Awful. Dr Murarka was rushed and didn’t seem confident. Didn’t completely examine my dog. Tried to upsell me on labs she admitted were unnecessary and runs very behind.

An extremely frustrating experience all around with Dr Murarka especially but All Ears as a whole.  Would not recommend.

Took in a malnourished stray kitten and they were able to get her checked out the next day. Every single person I talked to was so kind from the from desk to the doctor. I truly appreciate the level of care that went into our visit and the transparency when it came to pricing. Couldn’t have asked for a more successful visit and I feel relieved knowing my little girl is gonna be okay. Got blood and fecal test results back the next day!
The best vet experience I’ve had in years! I will be using them exclusively going forward for my entire menagerie of canine, feline, murine, and avian babies. 😊

I had a great experience with this vet. Everyone was polite and friendly and communicative, from the Front Desk staff to the nurse to the doctor. They were eager to address. All of my dogs needs while keeping costs to a minimum - this has not been my experience at other vets. as an added bonus, the facilities are beautiful. A++

I had a really really good experience at Bella’s appointment from start to finish. The receptionist was nice and welcoming, and the veterinary assistant who helped me before meeting the doctor was very patient and made me feel comfortable while going over Bella’s health history. I was worried about what was going on with her, so I appreciated everyone being kind and helpful. Dr. Ryan Fortier was also great and explained everything in a way I could understand. The office was clean, the staff was friendly, and I felt like Bella was really cared for. I truly appreciate everyone taking care of my girl.

I came to All Ears needing a time sensitive second opinion for my rabbit and was luckily able to be fit in quickly to see Dr. Emily, who I know is moving on from the practice, alongside an incredibly caring exotic staff and support staff. From beginning to end our visit was comfortable, and met with intelligent discussion and compassion for my bun’s health. Our follow up notes were detailed and turned around in a timely fashion - very helpful for next steps. I feel grateful to have had such a good experience and will look forward to coming to see their new Exotics expert when they come on board.
They are a great vet and all are so nice and treat me with kindness and love my dog
Dr.Emily was great with my turtle and the information she told me was very understanding.

The front desk staff were so friendly and welcoming. Nurse Emily listened intently as I brought her up to speed on my dog's past experiences at the vet. The Dr. Murarka and their assistant were the most patient with my anxious and fearful dog. They are the first team that were able to examine my dog properly. In fact, they were even apologetic that they couldn't do a more in-depth examination without further stressing out my big baby. Mind you, most doctors had never even attempted to look at my dog's teeth. This doctor looked over my shoulder as I pried my dog's mouth open to show her something else that was of concern. I'm definitely bringing my other dog here for her vet needs.

Very kind staff! They handled my cat very nicely to her to make her comfortable for her first visit with All Ears. Doctor addressed all of our questions and explained her exam of our cat very well. I’ll definitely be coming back to All Ears as our primary vet for our cat!

Jasper, our new nine-week puppy, had the most wonderful experience here (and we did, too!) The entire staff radiates good vibes and care. Dr. Fortier was patient, thorough, knowledgeable and kind. We feel so lucky to have our dog in excellent hands. (If only healthcare for humans was as good as this…)

I love everything about this place but the prices- it's very expensive to bring my dogs but they're too fantastic not to. Love internet accessibility, the communication, the place itself is clean and very nice. All the vets have been great.

Cannot recommend this practice enough. Had a last minute visit for my Stormy and the staff and Doctors were nothing short of kind, understanding, helpful and above all else the most gentle and patient with my baby. Very straightforward, consulted with ease and Churus were plentiful. Exam rooms were CLEAN and practical, quiet and comfortable. Dr. Murarka listened to everything I had to say and even though the appointment was last minute (2 days before) they had even gone ahead and contacted my last vet to get Stormy’s entire record prepared before we even walked in the door. Follow up questions were answered promptly and any issues with invoices were quickly addressed and fixed - efficient and caring! Many thanks to the front desk staff, Igor, Dr. Murarka and Dr. Fortier for their kindness and help!!

This was my pups first visit and it was a positve experience. Everyone was welcoming and friendly. The premises were immaculate and  Dr Haines had a gentle manner that my pup responds well to. I definately felt that my pup was in good hands.
From start to finish, we had an incredible experience. they were understanding, kind, and so good to our cat. Couldn't recommend more!

Took my Gemini for a post neuter check up! He got so many compliments on his bravey. Both Emily's. Dr & and vet-tech, were super fabulous and made my Gemi feel so safe and comfy. They truly care for our exotic little ones yall 💗Definitely making this our home vet 🐇🐇

We all were received with loving care. Both my BD and daughters cat were very comfortable during there exams. The entire staff was warm and loving to all of us. Thank you All Ears Veterinary Clinic. ❤️🐈‍⬛❤️🦎💐
Cannot recommend this place enough. From the great facilities, to transparent pricing, to incredible staff and doctor…. Simply the best. Would recommend to anyone and everyone!

The staff are wonderful. From check in to being in the room with the dr everything was amazing. They are very friendly and make your concerns a top priority. This is where i will always come back to if i need any more vet visits.
Amazing experience with both of my cats at All Ears, great communication, great care for our fur babies, and I'm very happy to have a go-to vet office with them. Thank you team!!
We had trouble finding a vet and All Ears knocked it out of the park for us. Our turtle was well taken care of and the staff & vet were so informative. This is now our home veterinary going forward.

I don’t think I could have handled putting down my soul dog of 13.5 years without the AllEars team. I had a horrible experience at VERG, and feel so lucky to have Dr. Emily and Igor help me navigating the dreaded day. It has been a few months now, and I will never forget calling Dr. Emily on the phone several times asking if I had made the right decision to schedule the euthanasia appointment. She was so incredibly kind and patient, despite likely dealing with this on a daily basis. I felt as reassured and supported as I could, and when we arrived to the appointment, Dr. Emily and Igor had such gentle bedside manner that it quite literally felt like a peaceful sleep. I especially appreciated Igor sharing his personal experience with pet loss throughout the process. I am eternally grateful to this team, including the amazing front desk team, for being there in our most time of need and help navigate one of the most traumatic weeks I have ever had. I ask a lot of questions and this was certainly no exception. To be met with such patience and kindness, I cannot overstate how needed and appreciated that was. This is not a paid review, I do not ever write google reviews unless my experience was exceptionally good or bad. If I decide to adopt in the future, I will come here. Cannot speak on pricing but I personally felt it was reasonable compared to VERG. I did not have insurance
Incredibly kind staff, they really care about your pets. Never feel pressured into anything that may not be necessary. Doctors always take the time to explain everything. Clean, easy booking online!
WE love our Dr Fortier. We love everyone who works here who has the magic pet touch. The only time in my life an animal of mine loves to come to the vet.
The Team at All Ears was so wonderful with my new rescue dog. It was super easy to get him in for a same-day appointment, and the staff was caring, kind, and clear.

Helped a lot with my rabbit taught my new things an answered all of my questions.
Thank you a lot

Very friendly staff, they treated my puppy right away and Dr. Checked him all out. Not like a previous vet I visited which pushes everything on you to purchase even if not needed. So far my chesnut is doing much better .ADDITIONAL  2026....As much as my pup is scared of the vet, no matter who attends him they are always polite and comforting to my baby chesnut.  Thank-you
Every was very kind and helpful. Dr.Haines show a lot of compassion and experience when handling Momo. She did a wonderful job explaining everything to me and answered all of my questions.
I took my bird in because it was ill. I received the best service ever at All Ears Veterinary… they’re very nice and kind people! 💫🐕‍🦺🦮🐈🐩🦜🦥

Can't recommend this vet enough.
The facility is clean and well-appointed, and everyone you interact with is incredibly kind and friendly. The vets and techs alike have great bedside manner, and every staff member clearly loves animals. No matter how stupid or neurotic my questions are, the vets (particularly Dr. Ryan and Dr. Emily) take time and effort to answer thoroughly and put my mind at ease. I've never had trouble making an appointment, and they've been able to fit my dog in for same-day or next-day appts every time.

I want to give a huge shoutout in particular to Tiera, who went above and beyond for me helping with a logistical issue. When my groomer insisted on a very specific type of paperwork, Tiera took charge, called the groomer personally, arranged for the paperwork to be sent, and then called me back to update me, all within ten minutes and with an incredibly pleasant and kind manner. Give this woman a raise -- she's amazing!

If you're looking for a vet in BK, seriously check out All Ears -- every staff member is amazing.
We love All Ears!!! They are truly the best. So supportive, understanding and efficient. Thank you team!

We love All Ears. Since starting there about 2 years ago, we have sent at least 3 more pet owners to them and all of us are happy and satisfied. Dr Fortier is the best. He’s so smart and so straight forward, yet kind. Aurora is an amazing vet assistant. She was thorough, thoughtful and knowledgeable. She made our visit much more comfortable. And Christine the office manager is beyond intelligent and caring.

I was so nervous being it was my geckos first time at the vet. Everyone was friendly, kind, and gentle with him! Dr. Was knowledgeable and answered all my questions with patience. Not to mention the team helped with his issue! He seems to be feeling much better!

I just got my first puppy (which is a breed that is notorious for having unique health concerns) so I did a TON of research when it came to finding a great vet in the area! I knew I wanted a stellar and gentle vet that my puppy felt comfortable with, to build positive associations with receiving care in the future. Everyone at All Ears is so extremely friendly, competent, and most importantly they clearly LOVE their patients! Dr Ryan was on the exam room floor playing with my puppy and giving him treats, and I am so excited for my puppy to be one of his regular patients! Dr Ryan took time to get to know my puppy and explain various facets of his health and ongoing care to me. After the preliminary examination, a nurse/assistant came to the exam room and presented me with a couple of options for vaccinations we could receive during the visit, and prices for each. I really appreciated that no care was administered without my approval, and the transparency surrounding pricing, so that there was no anxiety or surprises at checkout.

Tiera, at the front desk, is the best!! She was so helpful and kind both over the phone and via email, and patiently answered my 16 million questions leading up to our first visit.

While the visit fee is a bit higher than other vets I considered establishing care with, it feels unquestionably worth it to me to know that my little guy's health is in amazing and loving hands, and that communication with me will be empathetic, informative, and kind. 10/10 recommend, especially to new pet parents!
Lovely first experience! They fit me in as a new patient very quickly and were very gentle with my pup!
I've had nothing but a great experience at All Ears! Dr. Fortier is so thorough and kind, and he really takes his time to explain or answer any questions. Really grateful to have found All Ears!

Friendly Staff, Clean Clinic, and Excellent Follow-Up Care

I had a very positive experience with All Ears Veterinary during my dog’s annual checkup. The staff is extremely friendly and welcoming, and the clinic itself is very clean and well maintained.

I also really appreciated their level of care and attention — after our visit they checked in with us once we got home and even followed up again the next day. That kind of thoughtful follow-up makes a big difference.

Overall, a great experience and I would definitely recommend All Ears Veterinary to anyone looking for a caring and professional veterinary clinic. 🐾
When my beloved Janis passed away, I received a very thoughtful card in the mail, signed by several of the staff sending my family heartfelt condolences. Amazing!

Can’t say enough good things about this place. We showed up unannounced for an urgent care and they didn’t have any available appointments but they went out of their way to help us find a nearby vet. Very grateful. Thank you.

100/10 for their treatment of guinea pigs. My guinea pigs who are typically a bit skiddish and difficult to handle were extremely relaxed and happy while at All Ears Vet -even though through a nail trim. Each time one of them would squirm or squeal, the team was patient, gentle, and soothing to get the job done. I asked several silly questions as a new guinea pig owner and it was a judgement-free and helpful space. It was absolutely worth the travel from the Bronx to Brooklyn at 7:30 in the morning to bring them here. The price is worth the quality of care and as a former dog owner is reasonable for vet services in NYC!
I'm so happy to have a trustworthy exotics vet in our neighborhood. Emily and her team at All Ears were very thorough, gentle, transparent and kind. Highly recommend

I have a finicky little crested gecko I brought in for his first checkup since he seemed to not be feeling totally well. The All Ears team was absolutely fabulous with him. If you are searching for an exotic vet, look no further! I am so happy to have found an exotic vet who handled my little guy with such care and caution. The office is spick-and-span clean and every staff person I spoke with was helpful and friendly. Attached a photo of my little man just because.
Thank you so much for being so gentle and kind to my puppy..

I brought my pet rabbit Luna to All Ears Vet for the first time and I am truly blown away by how kind and caring everyone was. Luna is almost ten years old, I have had her her whole life, so she means absolutely everything to me. As we know, with age comes a few health concerns, and I was feeling nervous going in.

Both Dr. Emily Haines and Tiffany, the tech, were fantastic. They were gentle, compassionate, and took the time to walk me through options and thoughtful improvements I can make to support Luna’s quality of life. I felt heard, supported, and never rushed.

The front desk staff was warm and welcoming, and the overall atmosphere is calm and inviting. I am so grateful to have found this practice and will absolutely be making them Luna’s primary vet moving forward. Highly recommend. 🐰

I had a very positive experience when my dog ingested a piece of a tennis ball.  The staff were very friendly and had time to discuss issues with me.   In particular, the veterinarian himself was super informative and shared lots of info I found useful.

The post-visit report they gave me was well formatted and informative as well (and there was an unexpected $50 off for a first time visitor.

My only issue with the practice is that the signage is a little high so I would suggest a sign closer to the sidewalk level for pedestrians.
I have had a great experience with their staff and doctors, i feel very comfortable with them.

Everyone involved was extremely kind, caring, and Dr. Kasprow was extremely thorough and gave me a really detailed explanation of everything. It wasn't unreasonably expensive. I really appreciated it.

Horrible. I went there for a while but the owner is rude and the staff is constantly leaving. If you want reliable and consistent care from the same vet then this is not the place to go. They were aggressive and forceful with my dog during blood work and now he’s scared of going to the vet.
Great experience. Knowledgeable and kind staff. In and out fast. Beautiful space
I will recommend this place to anyone that has a pet in need. They are wonderful great great experience and they take their time to let you know what's wrong with your pet.

Generally positive overall. The nurses themselves are calm, professional, and genuinely good with dogs. I would have no hesitation in them personally working with my dogs again.

Unfortunately, the same cannot be said for management and clinic policy. The so-called “annual health examinations” provided were effectively copy-paste templates with the pet’s name inserted, plus generic observations that any attentive pet owner could reasonably make at home. There was no sense of tailored medical assessment or added clinical value.

More concerning is that the practice refuses to acknowledge health inspections or examinations performed elsewhere. This effectively forces clients into an economic closed loop, where ongoing care and even routine vaccinations are contingent on repeatedly paying for in-house exams, regardless of a pet’s actual health status or recent external evaluations.

When I raised these concerns, the response from management was dismissive rather than transparent or customer-focused, and I was advised to seek care elsewhere rather than engage in a reasonable discussion.

The frontline staff deserve credit, but the policies and management approach feel commercially driven and restrictive. As a result, I’ve chosen to take my business elsewhere to VetCo Clinics, which are not only more customer-centric, but give me the option to decide what inspections I want to do and when based on my dog’s best interests and actual needs.
